svg.title: Role Battle Day 03 combat rules and life state mind map
svg.desc: A manually authored detailed mind map of the central combat permission service, authoritative rule context, replicated life-state machine, fail-closed policy, consumers, tests, and future handoffs.
svg.text: Day 03 — one combat rule surface and one life-state truth
2026-08-09 | identity + trusted context + current state → structured relationship, permission, and rejection reason
AURA COMBAT RULES
CanCombatTarget and CanDamage answer permission.
Interaction remains separate; authority owns policy and state.
DAY 03 COMPLETE
DECISION INPUTS
Current server facts, not caller claims
Source and target combat identities
Source and target life state
Query purpose and server world context
Optional authoritative policy snapshot
Client target data cannot supply permission booleans.
CONSERVATIVE POLICY
Missing resolver means deny, never allow
Player ↔ Enemy: hostile and conditionally allowed
Same faction: friendly and denied
Player/Enemy → Civilian: protected and denied
Civilian source: cannot target or damage
PvP and Civilian damage remain denied until Day 12 resolves
a trusted battle-zone policy.
STRUCTURED OUTPUT
Explain the answer, not only true or false
Relationship: Friendly / Hostile / Neutral / Protected
Separate target and damage permission flags
Stable reason: invalid, self, friendly, protected, policy
or life state such as Dying / Dead / Respawning
Distance and threat score may rank permitted candidates;
they never redefine the relationship.
LIFE-STATE MACHINE
Replicated and authority-only
Alive → Dying → Dead
Replacement pawn: Respawning → initialized → Alive
Old pawn remains Dead; it is never revived
Repeated TryEnterDying returns false and publishes no second
death notification.
CONSUMERS
One policy, different query purposes
IsNotFriend becomes a deprecated rules wrapper
Enemy AI: Player identity → CanCombatTarget → nearest
FireGun impact: permitted target and still Alive
Interaction: deliberately not a combat-rule query
Threat direction is candidate-to-observer damage eligibility.
GUARDS AND VALIDATION
Authority controls state and permissive context
✓ Client state mutation denied
✓ Client policy mutation denied
✓ 8/8 Day 03 tests; 14/14 Day 01–03 suite
✓ Listen and Dedicated two-client reports pass
✓ Civilian default denial and Enemy targeting pass
2026-08-13 rerun: all 35 Aura tests exited 0, including Day 03.
Locked handoff
Day 11 may add role-specific death dispatch on top of this state truth; it must not replace it. Day 12 is the only production owner of permissive zone policy.
Until then, protected and untrusted cases stay denied, and interaction stays orthogonal to combat permission.
FAIL-CLOSED RULE
No trusted policy → no permission
Identity + state + trusted context → relationship → permission → stable reason → replicated evidence
